Deep in the deadly jungles of Junic there where ancient temples where ancient rituals were performed. This place is very attractive to archeologists due to the many artifacts that remain here. However they might not have fully understood what they were dealing with.

> Moon Map

> Moon Info

POPULATION: Several tribes detected, no human life in designated area.

CONDITIONS: Warm, very lush terrain, supports plenty of flora, always sunny.

FAUNA: A very healthy ecosystem, fauna exhibits neutral behaviour.

> Weather

Junic can experience Rainy, Stormy, Foggy, Flooded, Eclipsed, Earthquakes, Forsaken, Hallowed, or Hurricane weather by default.

> Moon Exclusive Content

Inside & Outside Ambience

On Junic you can hear two ambiences. One plays inside while the other one plays outside.

Outside Ambience

Inside Ambience

Carnivorous Roses

Junic's exterior has several small and large roses that temporarily trap any player that walks into them. The small roses will deal 22 damage to the player while the large roses will deal 90 damage to the player before releasing them. Additionally, Junic's exterior is somewhat foggy and can be confusing to navigate due to rocks and trees that fall and block pathways at specific points in time if a player is nearby.

Ritual Circle

Near one of the fire exits, there exists a ritual circle on the ground. To reach it, head straight from the back of the ship and turn right, turn left into a narrow pathway, continue walking along the path until the next intersection and turn left, and follow the path until reaching the fire exit and ritual circle. Entering this circle normally will result in a short cutscene and death. During that cutscene you can hear voice of Devils of Junic.



However, if the player holds the scrap "Jack's skull", which randomly spawns as scrap within the interior of Junic or is randomly available for purchase in the gift shop on Galetry, the player will survive. A new shortcut between the fire exit and the ship will be unlocked, the exterior and interior will emit a red glow, and the player will see a dramatically different exterior. Additionally, another path opens up near the back right of the ship and to the left of the log translator. Following this path shows a giant cubic skull and unlocks Roart.

Major Story Spoilers: Decision Aftermath

If players decided to overload and blow up ResearcherxB, debris from the ship can fall onto Junic's exterior. If players land on Junic in the future on that save file, a mild outbreak of white mold will be present on the exterior and Infected Bunker Spiders will spawn on the exterior at the start of the day.

> Progression

Unlocked By

Logging "Geoffrey's final message" found on the exterior of Asteroid-13.
Alternatively, inserting the Junic videotape that randomly spawns as scrap within the interiors of Acidir, Alcatras, Gloom, Hyve, or Vow into the projector in Galetry.

Unlocks

Acidir: Acidir videotape that randomly spawns as scrap within the interior.
Chasm: Interact with the note found on the wall of a tent on the exterior.
Etern: Log "Geoffrey's log 4" found on the exterior.
Gloom: Gloom videotape that randomly spawns as scrap within the interior.
Roart: Complete the ritual described in Junic's moon exclusive content and approach the hidden cubic skull.

> Lore

Geoffrey's Log 4

The log can be found by following the flares on the left when exiting the ship.

Text ⁠
Last night..
I heard the news..
The cities of Trite have been made one with the ground.
They bombed almost the entire moon!
And now they are laying waste to whomever survived the attack.

I send out many MANY messages to ask for my family.
The emperor has refused to answer. How weird I thought.
But ooooh those left on Trite sure answered!

They told me there were no reports of anyone arriving from Calist before or after the Catalyst.

My family.. my children.. my Maddy.
They never even left in the first place.

No effort was made to even try to get them out of there in time.
And the emperor has been lying to me!
He has been lying to me since the very start of this hell!
I thought he may have had it all planned out but this.. grand war.
All that I have done..
I should never have trusted him.

I am ceasing the operations here.
And I will be moving into my final mission but I won’t be following his plans.

Agent G- Signing off.

Desmond's Notes

Desmond's Note 1

Image & Text ⁠
I thought I would write about our findings.
During the excavation we laid eyes upon an ancient golden mask.
I bet this is worth millions considering where it came from!

It was perhaps used by the ancient people of this moon.
Not quite sure what for however. I do feel it has a creepy look to it.
Maybe my fellow archeologist Jack might have an idea.
Here's a sketch:

Desmond's Note 2

Image & Text ⁠
Yesterday Jack claimed to have found an ancient dagger.
He was eager to tell the crew but he does not want to let go of it.
This is quite strange behaviour for Jack so I went to investigate this blade.

He left it next to his bed while he was asleep.
I snuck in and tried to grab it but.. It was incredibly heavy.
Which is weird considering jack was able to carry it fine.
However, in his sleep, I heard him mumble about some ancient note or.. ritual..
Certainly strange.

Desmond's Note 3

Image & Text ⁠
I AM IN SHOCK!
When Jack came in earlier he was completely covered in blood!
He has lost his mind!
He was holding the dagger in his right hand and the mask in his left held before his face.
He looked at me.
Chanting soem unrecognisable words before he walked away. Seemingly heading outside.

I am not sure if he killed an animal or..
I need to make sure Dave is ok.
I don't want to be alone with Jack the lunatic.
Maybe I should go look what's outside.

I fear the worst.
